description: Compliance under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 and BIS Mandatory Registration Scheme.

requirements.title: Generic Name of Electronic / Electrical Device
requirements.description: Generic description of the device must be clearly stated (e.g., Wireless Charger, LED Bulb, USB Cable).
requirements.recommendation_template: Declare the generic name of the electronic or electrical device on the package.

requirements.title: Manufacturer / Importer Name & Address
requirements.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or Indian importer must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: Provide registered Indian importer or manufacturer name and complete address.

requirements.title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Import
requirements.description: Month and year of manufacture or importation must be clearly printed.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print month and year of manufacture or import (MM/YYYY) on the package.

requirements.title: Package Unit Count (N / Units)
requirements.description: Number of units or pieces contained in the package (e.g., 1 N, 2 Units).
requirements.recommendation_template: Declare package unit count clearly (e.g., '1 N' or '1 Unit').

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price — MRP (Incl. of all taxes)
requirements.description: MRP inclusive of all taxes must be stated in Indian Rupees.
requirements.recommendation_template: State MRP in INR inclusive of all taxes on the package.

requirements.title: Customer Service / Consumer Care Details
requirements.description: Customer care telephone number and email address for consumer grievances.
requirements.recommendation_template: Include active customer service helpline number and support email.

requirements.title: Country of Origin
requirements.description: Country of origin is mandatory on all electronic and electrical packages.
requirements.recommendation_template: Specify Country of Origin clearly (e.g., 'Made in India', 'Country of Origin: China').
